question: A solid, neutral conducting sphere of radius $3R$ has a concentric spherical cavity of radius $R$. A point charge $+Q$ is fixed at the center of the cavity. Let $V_1$ be the potential at a point $r=2R$ from the center. Now, the outer surface of the sphere is earthed. Let $V_2$ be the new potential at the same point. What are the values of $V_1$ and $V_2$?
